title: Light-driven water oxidation by a BiVO4/TiO2 photoanode modified with D102 organic dye and copper(II) meso-tetra(4-carboxyphenyl)porphyrin
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00543K, Paper
Andi Mauliana, Muhammad Iqbal Syauqi, Zico Alaia Akbar, Uji Pratomo, Jacob Yan Mulyana, Tribidasari A. Ivandini
To improve its photoelectrocatalytic water oxidation properties, a BiVO4 photoanode was integrated with TiO2 modified by Indoline D102 dye and copper(II) meso-tetra(4-carboxyphenyl)porphyrin (CuTCPP).
